description: Regression cases: real defects found during development or use. Never remove a valid case because the implementation changed.

cases.query: add a continue watching row on the home screen
cases.note: 2026-09-08 Phase 2: the first facet-coverage implementation swapped out comp-tv-rail (strong lexical match) for nav-tv-side (no lexical match) to satisfy the navigation facet. Fixed with the swap_ratio guard (incoming ≥ 0.75 × outgoing).

cases.query: WinUI desktop ERP data grid with keyboard shortcuts
cases.note: 2026-09-08 Phase 2: Phase 1 known limitation (universal interaction rule crowded out by ERP-specific records). Fixed structurally by facet-aware result composition, not by a keyboard bonus.
2026-09-08 Phase 2: required facets exceeded the slot budget (6 facets, k=5), making PARTIAL status unavoidable for terse TV queries. Fixed by capping required facets to k-1.
